replacements.Cómo medir el progreso hacia AGI: How to measure progress towards AGI
replacements.Cinco dimensiones distintas: ingeniería: Five different dimensions: software engineering, real autonomy, general reasoning, frontier hard sciences, and direct scientific impact. Select a benchmark to explore the evolution.
replacements.<strong>SWE-bench Verified</strong> — 50: SWE-bench Verified — 500 real GitHub bugs. An autonomous model reads the repo, identifies the failure, and generates the correct patch without seeing the validation tests. It measures real-world software engineering, not code completion in an IDE.
replacements.SWE-bench Pro (2025-2026) · variante más: SWE-bench Pro (2025-2026) · harder variant · current models ~30-40% — the benchmark gets harder when the previous one saturates
replacements.De 1,7% en 2023 a 76,8% en feb 2026 — en: From 1.7% in 2023 to 76.8% in Feb 2026 — in less than three years. Numbers with mini-SWE-agent v2 (standard evaluation). The field is now moving to SWE-bench Pro, where scores fall again (30-55%), a sign that benchmarks saturate before the real problem is solved.
replacements.Fuente: swebench.com · leaderboard ofici: Source: swebench.com · official mini-SWE-agent v2.0.0 leaderboard (Feb 2026)
replacements.<strong>Horizonte temporal de tareas</st: Task time horizon (METR, Mar 2025): the maximum task duration an agent completes with 50% reliability. It does not measure answering questions, but sustained multi-step work. It doubles roughly every ~7 months.
replacements.Escala log · eje en tiempo de tarea (50%: Log scale · axis in task time (50% reliability)
replacements.De 1-2 min en 2021 a 2h 15min en 2025. L: From 1-2 min in 2021 to 2h 15min in 2025. The next frontier is days: that is where real autonomy appears — planning, execution, and self-correction without continuous human supervision. At that horizon, agency risks change qualitatively.
replacements.Fuente: METR — Measuring AI Ability to C: Source: METR — Measuring AI Ability to Complete Long Tasks (Mar 2025, metr.org) · OpenAI GPT-5 System Card (Aug 2025)
replacements.<strong>ARC-AGI</strong> mide inteligenc: ARC-AGI measures fluid intelligence: reasoning about completely new problems from very few examples. ARC-AGI-1 was solved by o3 in 2024 (87.5%). ARC-AGI-2 (launched Mar 2025) was designed to resist scaling — but in one year progress has been faster than expected.
replacements.o3 cruzó el umbral del 85% que define «v: o3 crossed the 85% threshold that defines “beating” ARC-AGI-1. The benchmark is considered completed.
replacements.feb 2026 · verificado ARC Prize Foundati: Feb 2026 · verified by ARC Prize Foundation
replacements.De 4% en el lanzamiento (mar 2025) a 84,: From 4% at launch (Mar 2025) to 84.6% in one year. The threshold for “beating” ARC-AGI-2 is ~85%. SOTA: Gemini 3 Deep Think, verified by the ARC Prize Foundation (Feb 2026).
replacements.ARC-AGI-2: de 4% (mar 2025) a 84,6% (feb: ARC-AGI-2: from 4% (Mar 2025) to 84.6% (Feb 2026) in less than a year — unprecedented progress
replacements.ARC-AGI-2 fue diseñado para resistir el: ARC-AGI-2 was designed to resist pure scaling. It is resisting less than expected: in under 12 months models went from 4% to 84.6%. Each task is solved by ≥2 humans in ≤2 attempts; humans score ~98%. ARC-AGI-1 took 5 years to solve; ARC-AGI-2 could fall within months.
replacements.Fuente: arcprize.org/leaderboard (datos: Source: arcprize.org/leaderboard (data 18 Mar 2026) · Gemini 3 Deep Think announcement, blog.google (12 Feb 2026) · ARC Prize Foundation
replacements.Benchmarks que miden razonamiento cientí: Benchmarks that measure elite scientific reasoning: from questions designed to be unsolvable by any AI to international Olympiads and quantum physics under active research. In all of them, the reference is a human expert with time and resources.
replacements.GPQA Diamond — Preguntas de nivel PhD en: GPQA Diamond — PhD-level questions in physics, chemistry, and biology
replacements.Preguntas diseñadas por doctorandos para: Questions designed by PhD students to be unsolvable through Google. The bar is that a domain expert (not the author) gets them right with time and references.
replacements.Los modelos frontier superan la mediana: Frontier models have surpassed the median PhD expert on this benchmark since 2024
replacements.Tres benchmarks que miden lo que antes s: Three benchmarks that measure what was previously considered exclusively human territory: theoretical-physics research, international science Olympiads, and questions designed to be unsolvable by any model.
replacements.Física cuántica de materia condensada ·: Condensed-matter quantum physics · open research problems
replacements.Primer resultado significativo en un ben: First significant result on a frontier theoretical-physics benchmark. No published human baseline — active-research questions.
replacements.Diseñado para ser el benchmark más difíc: Designed to be the hardest possible benchmark. Human experts with time score ~85-90%. First time any model exceeds 40% without tools.
replacements.Olimpiada Internacional de Física y Quím: International Physics and Chemistry Olympiad · written section
replacements.Nivel medalla de oro en la sección escri: Gold-medal level on the written section of both Olympiads — the exam the world's best physics and chemistry students complete over days.
replacements.Fuente: blog.google — Gemini 3 Deep Thin: Source: blog.google — Gemini 3 Deep Think announcement · 12 Feb 2026
replacements.El patrón es el mismo en todos: los mode: The pattern is the same in all of them: models crossed the bar of the human expert with time and resources. The next leap is not beating tests — it is solving physics problems humans have not yet solved, as CMT-Benchmark already asks them to do.
replacements.Fuente: GPQA Diamond (Rein et al., arXiv: Source: GPQA Diamond (Rein et al., arXiv 2023) · Gemini 3 Deep Think announcement (blog.google, 12 Feb 2026) · HLE (Scale AI, 2025) · IPhO / IChO 2025
replacements.La IA <strong>aplicada directamente</str: AI applied directly to real scientific-research problems: nuclear fusion, materials discovery, protein design, weather prediction, and the autonomous scientific cycle.
replacements.IA aplicada a ciencia real — DeepMind &: AI applied to real science — DeepMind & Google
replacements.DeepMind entrenó una red neuronal de ref: DeepMind trained a reinforcement-learning neural network that controls the shape of magnetic plasma in Lausanne's TCV reactor in real time. First autonomous control of simultaneous plasma configurations published in Nature (2022).
replacements.DeepMind + CFS · IA para fusión nuclear: DeepMind + CFS · AI for nuclear fusion
replacements.Google DeepMind se asoció con Commonweal: Google DeepMind partnered with Commonwealth Fusion Systems (CFS) to bring AI to the SPARC tokamak — the first designed to reach breakeven (more fusion energy than it consumes). Three axes: the TORAX simulator (JAX, open source) for millions of virtual experiments, RL to optimise reactor operation, and real-time plasma control. Google also invested in CFS. Built on the TCV/EPFL RL control work (Nature 2022).
replacements.Graph Networks for Materials Exploration: Graph Networks for Materials Exploration discovered 2.2 million stable crystal structures — 800 times more than the entire history of crystallography. 381,000 candidates for batteries, superconductors, and semiconductors. Some have already been synthesised in the laboratory.
replacements.Extiende la predicción de estructura más: Extends structure prediction beyond proteins to RNA, DNA, ligands, and their mutual interactions. A foundation for drug design. AlphaProteo generates binding-protein designs for specific therapeutic targets with an unprecedented success rate.
replacements.Nature 2024 · Nobel de Química 2024 (Has: Nature 2024 · 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry (Hassabis & Baker)
replacements.Supera en precisión a los modelos numéri: Outperforms ECMWF numerical models in accuracy on 10-day forecasts, at a fraction of the computational cost. Used in production for hurricane alerts. First AI model to beat the operational physics-based standard for global weather forecasting.
replacements.Science 2023 · En producción en Google W: Science 2023 · In production in Google Weather
replacements.Sistema totalmente autónomo de investiga: Fully autonomous scientific-research system: generates hypotheses, designs experiments, implements code, analyses results, and writes complete papers, including peer review of other papers. Cost: ~$15 per complete paper. First demonstration of automation of the full scientific cycle.
replacements.Sakana AI · arXiv 2024 · Ciclo científic: Sakana AI · arXiv 2024 · Autonomous scientific cycle
replacements.Combina Gemini con algoritmos evolutivos: Combines Gemini with evolutionary algorithms to discover and optimise code. Rediscovered an improvement to a matrix-multiplication algorithm that had not been improved for 56 years. Active improvements in the Borg cluster scheduler, TPU chip design, and Google's data centres. Direct operational productivity on production infrastructure.
replacements.El patrón es consistente: la IA no reemp: The pattern is consistent: AI does not replace the scientist; it lets them explore a hypothesis space millions of times larger in the same time. The bottleneck shifts from “generating candidates” to “synthesising and validating them” in the laboratory.
